cases.name: mutable_default_cart
cases.title: Carts share items through a mutable default argument
cases.diagnosis: The `Cart` class's `__init__` method initializes `items` with a default mutable list, which causes all instances to share the same list.
cases.diff:
--- a/cart.py
+++ b/cart.py
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 class Cart:
-    def __init__(self, owner, items=[]):
+    def __init__(self, owner, items=None):
+        if items is None:
+            items = []
         self.owner = owner
         self.items = items
